items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: And then at that time, I ran into a guy named -- well, Jesse Price and Shep, the bass player.

ctx.x: Uh-huh, and so I'm back in South Bend now. See, otherwise, I wouldn't have left the coast, because I had some things that I wanted to do. But after leaving the coast I went back to Chicago, I said, well, I'm back here now. It was only about 90 miles out of Chicago, South Bend. And so I started doing a few gigs around there.
And then at that time, I ran into a guy named -- well, Jesse Price and Shep, the bass player.
